Class OpponentsSidebarViewController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am32.client.view.gui.controllers.OpponentsSidebarViewController
public class OpponentsSidebarViewController extends Object
The opponent sidebar controller is represented during a game session.

A per-nickname cache of OpponentView instances is maintained so each view is created only once. Interaction handlers are registered in the same computeIfAbsent call and bound exactly once per view.

    • updateOpponents

      public void updateOpponents(Map<String, LightPlayer> players, String localPlayerName)
      The sidebar is synchronized with the current player map.

      Players no longer present in players are evicted from the cache. New players are assigned a fresh OpponentView with interaction handlers bound once. Existing views are updated in-place. The local player is excluded from the list.

      Parameters:
      players - the full player map from the current game state
      localPlayerName - the nickname of the local player to exclude
